entities.name: The Buried Lord
entities.description: Formidable ancient demon of Innistrad, briefly returned to life and banished by Liesa.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Angel brought back to life by the ritual who fought and killed the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Algli
entities.description: Desperate villager who helped summon the Buried Lord and later thrust a torch into his mouth.

entities.name: Olutio
entities.description: Villager summoner killed first by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Sruta
entities.description: Villager summoner pursued by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where the demon was summoned.

events.summary: Algli, Olutio and Sruta summon the Buried Lord to protect them from supernatural threats; the ritual seems to fail but brings Liesa back to life.
events.quote: The Buried Lord was summoned by a group of desperate villagers

events.summary: Liesa tells Algli the Buried Lord is a predator, not a protector.
events.quote: the Buried Lord was not a protector but a predator

events.summary: The Buried Lord begins a reign of terror, killing Olutio and pursuing Sruta.
events.quote: first killing Olutio and then pursuing Sruta

events.summary: Liesa fights the demon and drives him off by striking his spine.
events.quote: Liesa drove him away temporarily by striking a fatal blow to his spine.

events.summary: The demon returns and attacks Algli, who thrusts a torch into his mouth.
events.quote: Algli offered herself as a sacrifice but used the opportunity to thrust a torch into the demon's mouth

events.summary: Liesa decapitates the Buried Lord, banishing him from Innistrad.
events.quote: decapitating the Buried Lord and ensuring his demise and banishment from Innistrad once more

relations.quote: decapitating the Buried Lord and ensuring his demise
first killing Olutio and then pursuing Sruta
allowed Liesa to channel her power and deliver the true killing blow
